title: O comando /statusline salva a descrição textual diretamente no settings.json em vez de gerar o script de statusline

triage_metadata.reasoning: The issue requests that the /statusline command convert a natural language prompt (e.g., '/statusline mostrar diretório, modelo e contexto') into an executable statusline script or run a natural language customization wizard. In Gemini CLI, /statusline is an alias for /footer which opens an interactive UI dialog to toggle built-in footer elements, and does not support natural language prompt conversion into custom statusline scripts. This is a request for a new feature and capability that does not currently exist in the codebase.
